an1.616:1.1: te bhikkhave na paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṃ na paribhuñjanti.
an1.616:1.2: Amatan te bhikkhave paribhuñjanti ye kāyagatāsatiṃ paribhuñjantīti. 49. Amatan
an1.617:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave aparibhuttaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparibhuttā.

an1.618:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave parihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati parihīnā.
an1.618:1.2: Amatan tesaṃ bhikkhave aparihīnaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati aparihīnā ti. 53. Amatan

an1.620:1.1: te bhikkhave pamādiṃsu ye kāyagatāsatiṃ pamādiṃsu.

an1.621:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave pammuṭṭhaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati pammuṭṭhā.

an1.622:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave anāsevitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anāsevitā.
an1.622:1.2: Amatan tesaṃ bhikkhave āsevitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati āsevitā ti. 61. Amatan
an1.623:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave abhāvitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhāvitā.
an1.623:1.2: Amatan tesaṃ bhikkhave bhāvitaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati bhāvitā ti. 63. Amatan
an1.624:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave abahulīkataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abahulīkatā.

an1.625:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave anabhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati anabhiññātā.
an1.625:1.2: Amatan tesaṃ bhikkhave abhiññātaṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati abhiññātā ti. 67. Amatan
an1.627:1.1: tesaṃ bhikkhave asacchikataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati asacchikatā
an1.627:1.2: ti. 70. Amatan tesaṃ bhikkhave sacchikataṃ yesaṃ kāyagatāsati sacchikatā
